rows.note: Use 霧 as the all-purpose noun for ordinary atmospheric fog; 霧氣 emphasizes mist or condensation, while 腦霧 is mental.

example.english: The fog is really thick today, so drive carefully.
example.traditional: 今日啲霧好濃，揸車小心啲。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 di1 mou6 hou2 nung4 zaa1 ce1 siu2 sam1 di1

rows.note: Use 霧氣 when emphasizing the visible moisture, especially a misty film on glass or another surface.

example.english: There is fog on the glass, so I can't see clearly.
example.traditional: 塊玻璃有霧氣，睇唔清楚。
example.jyutping: faai3 bo1 lei1 jau5 mou6 hei3 tai2 m4 cing1 co2

rows.note: Use 腦霧 specifically for mental sluggishness and confusion, not physical fog.

example.english: I have brain fog all day today, so I am working slowly.
example.traditional: 我今日成日腦霧，做嘢好慢。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 seng4 jat6 nou5 mou6 zou6 je5 hou2 maan6
